name: Sap diagnostician
design: Tall angular young adult male with triangular blue-steel mask, flattened high central crest, narrow cyan eye recesses and two lower filters, swept-back thin dreadlocks in three hanging groups. Navy sleeveless outer coat over modest fully covered grey undersuit, indigo segmented working apron and brown strap harness. Right hand holds a small capped sap probe connected by short cable to a compact reader in left hand. Three microvials of subtle purple liquid on left hip, no syringe aimed at anyone.
